`expo` declares the `expo-modules` bin itself and forwards it to `expo-modules-cli`, so every package manager links it into `node_modules/.bin`, also with pnpm and bun isolated installs. `pnpm exec expo-modules` and `bunx expo-modules` run the same command. It needs `expo` installed in the module package; when the command is missing, install the module's dependencies. `--no-install` keeps `npx` from downloading a package from npm in that case.
